title: VSA celebrate A League title
description: Sokhumi - VSA 67-78 VSA clinched A League title and therefore punched Superleague ticket for the next season. They prevailed against Sokhumi 3-1 in the championship series. The guests trailed by 4 points at the halftime before their 43-28 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. VSA outrebounded Sokhumi 41-30 including 31 on the defensive glass. 25 personal fouls committed by Sokhumi helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American guard Kameron Warrens (196, college: Mary) fired a double-double by scoring 18 points and 12 rebounds for the winners. The other American import point guard Jermaine Head (186-1997, college: WILMU) chipped in 21 points and 6 assists.
